question: What were case reserves outstanding on bodily-injury claims at 31 December 2025?
final_text:
Case reserves outstanding on bodily-injury claims at 31 December 2025 were £11,574,541.29.

This is the calendar-basis `case_reserve` figure, filtered to peril = BODILY_INJURY, as at 31 December 2025 (period 2025). Case reserves are semi-additive, so the year-end balance is the right reading rather than a sum over the year.

ANSWER: 11574541.29
